sentences.text: J.M.F.C COURT, KANAKAPURA, RAMANAGARA DISTRICT IN  -3-  NC: 2023:KHC:28899  CRL.P No. 11271 of 2022 C.C.NO.1672/2022, SO FAR AS THE PETITIONERS ARE CONCERNED.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR REPORTING SETTLEMENT, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Petitioners-accused Nos.1,5,6,7,8 are sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506, 504, 114 r/w Section 149 of IPC, 1860, and Section 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo stating that the M.C.No.633/2022, filed by the accused No.1, was referred to the Mediation Centre to explore the possibility of the amicable settlement between the parties.

4. The parties before the Mediation Centre amicably settled the dispute among themselves, and as per the terms of the settlement, the marriage of the 2nd respondent with her husband-accused No.1 has been mutually dissolved, and the respondent No.2 has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.

The respondent No.2-wife has also received permanent alimony of Rs.55,00,000/-
through demand draft and gold ornaments.
5. The memo is placed on record.

6. Though the offences alleged against the petitioners- accused herein are cognizable and non-compoundable, NC: 2023:KHC:28899 however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves and the respondent No.2-defacto complainant having no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioners are subjected to trial, since the probability of their conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.
Hence, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The Criminal petition is allowed;
ii) The Impugned proceedings in C.C.No.1672/2022 arising out the Crime No.122/2021 registered by the Kodihalli Police Station, for the offence punishable under Section 498(A), 504, 506 and 114 r/w Section 149 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 Sri Vishwas B R vs State Of Karnataka on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188142184/
3 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending on the file of the learned Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Kanakapura, Ramanagara District, insofar it relates to Petitioners-accused Nos.1,5,6,7,8 is hereby quashed.
